CodeRabbit is the better dedicated code review tool. It reviews deeper, supports GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, and Bitbucket, includes 40+ built-in linters, and costs $24/user/month with a generous free tier covering unlimited repos. GitHub Copilot is the better all-in-one AI coding platform if you are already on GitHub and want code completion, chat, an autonomous coding agent, and code review bundled under one subscription starting at $10/month. If code review quality is your top priority, choose CodeRabbit.
